title: Injectivity of the partwise edge map
statement: Let $q,k\in\mathbb{N}$, choose a perfect matching in the complete $q$-partite graph with $k$ vertices per part, and fix a part. The map sending each position in that part to the matching edge containing the corresponding vertex is injective.
hypotheses_covered: a perfect matching in the complete q-partite graph
